selection_order: Retrospective extension of a known published experiment. Only metadata, times and the five zero-time entries of this CSV were inspected before fixing this protocol. All positive-time values are excluded from preparation, apparatus choices, numerical choices and prediction generation. This is not prospective or blinded evidence.
mapping_evidence: Paper Fig.5 caption and prose agree. Deposited README swaps d/e; zero-time row independently identifies d as the centred preparation. Executor phi has the opposite sign to the target potential phase, by the selected small-angle generator. No later trajectory selected this mapping.

preparation.primary: Reuse the earlier zero-time complex-scan alpha magnitude and thermal occupation, changing only declared sign or centre. No new fitted parameters.
preparation.secondary: Five independent zero-time displacement calibrations with the same fixed thermal occupation. Invert x=exp(-(nbar+1/2)*h^2)*sin(2*alpha*h)/(sqrt(2)*h) on its principal branch. The preparation domain is |alpha|<=pi/(4*h). No positive-time datum is used. This is a secondary preparation-adjusted analysis, not the no-new-fit transfer.
preparation.uncertainty: Neither prior preparation covariance nor authenticated zero-time accepted counts are available. Do not assign a statistical confidence region.

apparatus.carrier_duration: Each Rx takes |phi|/Omega0 with delta*N drift and the same dephasing; all three generators commute during that segment. Rz is virtual. Whether laboratory phase compensation cancels this drift is undocumented; instantaneous Rx is a predeclared sensitivity control.
apparatus.time_parameters: Published plotted coordinate K*200 us; drive elapsed duration K*(200 us+4*|phi|/Omega0) is retained separately. Neither is host runtime or native pulse count.
apparatus.selection: Retain full spin through all steps; only the terminal comparison conditions on spin down (code zero). Keep reject mass and both detector outcomes.

readout.data_type: Deposited derived two-point position estimator, not exact position expectation and not authenticated raw spin frequencies.
readout.normalization_issue: Zero-time printed values have quantization compatible with integer hundredths divided by .636, whereas the paper specifies h=.4. No authenticated alternative h or conversion is supplied. Use literal h=.4, do not rescale data or infer raw counts, and retain this as a provenance limitation.

numerics.environment: Positive standard-normal Gauss-Hermite mixture. Every branch phase is executed by native source words; supplied classical weights are summed exactly as a finite instrument law up to declared floating arithmetic.
numerics.certificate: Exact-rational outward bound for the ideal finite-dimensional symmetric split and ideal finite quadrature. Includes the truncated commutator boundary and terminal-conditioning amplification. Excludes floating execution, preparation, apparatus and occupation-removal errors.

refinement_comparisons: Step: d32/s256 versus d32/s128. Occupation: d64/s256 versus d32/s256. Secondary and controls: d32/s128. Occupation checks cover the transferred preparation only; they do not certify the secondary preparation-adjusted trajectories.
validation: All 25 positive published times (.4 to 10 ms) for all five cases: 125 derived observations, equal weight, no exclusions.
score: Descriptive RMSE in dimensionless two-point position-estimator units, separately per case and combined. No chi-squared, p-value or significance claim. Software all_pass means valid execution and comparison contracts, not empirical success.
scope: Single-mode conditional apparatus model, executed in the OPH source interface. Hamiltonian, preparation family, environment law, detector, classical stochastic draws and clock calibration remain supplied. Neither OPH-specific action selection, spatial dimension recovery nor a new QFT prediction is established.
